headword: {救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん}
reading: きゅうきゅうたいいん

definitions.gloss: paramedic; emergency medical technician; emergency responder
definitions.explanation: A member of an emergency medical team who responds to emergencies and provides pre-hospital medical care. In Japan, these personnel are typically affiliated with the fire department.

examples.japanese: {救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}けつけた→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: The paramedics rushed to the scene immediately.

examples.japanese: {救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}→応急処置：06519_oukyuushochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}した→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧。
examples.english: The emergency responders administered first aid to the patient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん}になって、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧がしたい。
examples.english: In the future, I want to become a paramedic and do work that saves people's lives.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧ ('emergency, first aid') + {隊員|たいいん} ('team member'). In Japan, emergency medical services (⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧) are operated by the fire department (⟦{消防署|しょうぼうしょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧), not as a separate service. When you call 119 (the emergency number in Japan), the fire department dispatches both ambulances and fire trucks.

Japanese {救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん} undergo specialized training and can include {救急救命士|きゅうきゅうきゅうめいし} (certified emergency life-saving technicians), who are authorized to perform advanced medical procedures.
